metadata.title: Corporate Learning and Skills Data Assets
metadata.description: Proposed logical data architecture. Active denotes an element of this reference design. Stores, access policies, retention and residency are not verified Studytube implementation facts.

rootGroups.name: Identity and Workforce
rootGroups.description: Governed logical assets supporting identity and workforce.

assets.name: Tenant Membership and Access Policy
assets.description: Tenant-local identities, role grants, privileged approvals and product entitlements; employer identity remains authoritative.
assets.businessMeaning: Tenant-local identities, role grants, privileged approvals and product entitlements; employer identity remains authoritative.
assets.accessScope: Only tenant administrators and scoped authorization services; temporary support access is approved and logged.

interfaces.name: Tenant Identity and Access API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Revoke access when authority ends; retain minimal access-change evidence under the agreed audit schedule.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Only tenant administrators and scoped authorization services; temporary support access is approved and logged. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Academy Workforce Projection
assets.description: An effective-dated projection of employer worker keys, roles, organization membership and account lifecycle, reconciled to HR.
assets.businessMeaning: An effective-dated projection of employer worker keys, roles, organization membership and account lifecycle, reconciled to HR.
assets.accessScope: Scoped employer administrators and membership consumers; managers only see their reporting population.

interfaces.name: Workforce Provisioning and Reconciliation API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Keep the projection for the active relationship and agreed learning-record continuity period; remove raw rejected HR payloads after the repair window.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Scoped employer administrators and membership consumers; managers only see their reporting population. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

rootGroups.name: Skills and Learning Evidence
rootGroups.description: Governed logical assets supporting skills and learning evidence.

assets.name: Role and Skill Definitions
assets.description: Versioned role expectations, skill definitions, levels, rubric references and business-owner approval history.
assets.businessMeaning: Versioned role expectations, skill definitions, levels, rubric references and business-owner approval history.
assets.accessScope: Employer role owners, L&D and authorized learners; cross-employer reuse requires explicit rights.

interfaces.name: Role and Skill Requirements API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Retain referenced versions while any assessment or plan depends on them; retire obsolete definitions from active selection.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Employer role owners, L&D and authorized learners; cross-employer reuse requires explicit rights. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Skill Assessment and Work Evidence
assets.description: Self, manager and peer observations with rubric version, date, provenance, disagreements and accepted evidence; not an employment decision score.
assets.businessMeaning: Self, manager and peer observations with rubric version, date, provenance, disagreements and accepted evidence; not an employment decision score.
assets.accessScope: Learner, authorized manager and selected reviewers; HR and analytics access are separately scoped.

interfaces.name: Skill Assessment and Evidence API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Keep for the employer-approved development purpose and review period; remove unnecessary narrative and honor corrections while preserving required provenance.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Learner, authorized manager and selected reviewers; HR and analytics access are separately scoped. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Development Goals and Practice Plans
assets.description: Agreed focus goals, learning choices, supported practice time, milestones and follow-up decisions.
assets.businessMeaning: Agreed focus goals, learning choices, supported practice time, milestones and follow-up decisions.
assets.accessScope: The learner and authorized coach or manager; L&D sees only the detail needed to support delivery.

interfaces.name: Development Plans and Practice API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Review at goal completion or role change; retain only the agreed longitudinal evidence and remove obsolete preferences.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: The learner and authorized coach or manager; L&D sees only the detail needed to support delivery. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Learning Recommendation Decisions
assets.description: Versioned recommendation results, eligibility rationale and feedback; no automatic promotion or suitability decisions.
assets.businessMeaning: Versioned recommendation results, eligibility rationale and feedback; no automatic promotion or suitability decisions.
assets.accessScope: Learner and authorized product-quality reviewers; aggregated reporting suppresses identifying detail.

interfaces.name: Relevant Learning Recommendations API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Keep identifiable decision traces only for the agreed explanation and evaluation window; use minimized aggregates for longer-term quality analysis.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Learner and authorized product-quality reviewers; aggregated reporting suppresses identifying detail. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Academy Presentation Configuration
assets.description: Tenant branding, navigation labels, featured content and accessibility preferences for the employer academy.
assets.businessMeaning: Tenant branding, navigation labels, featured content and accessibility preferences for the employer academy.
assets.accessScope: Tenant academy administrators; public display is limited to approved branding.

interfaces.name: Branded Employer Academy API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Retain active configuration and reversible version history for the tenant relationship; remove tenant-specific assets on agreed exit.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Tenant academy administrators; public display is limited to approved branding. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Learning Activity and Completion Record
assets.description: Attempts, resume state, completion status and source messages tied to a learner and course version. Completion is distinct from assessed skill.
assets.businessMeaning: Attempts, resume state, completion status and source messages tied to a learner and course version. Completion is distinct from assessed skill.
assets.accessScope: Learners see their own records; administrators and managers have purpose-scoped access.

interfaces.name: Learning Delivery and Progress API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Apply the employer-agreed learning evidence schedule; preserve relevant course-version references and correct erroneous records through an audited workflow.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Learners see their own records; administrators and managers have purpose-scoped access. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Learning Notification Record
assets.description: Notification intent, recipient scope, template version, delivery result and suppression decision.
assets.businessMeaning: Notification intent, recipient scope, template version, delivery result and suppression decision.
assets.accessScope: Tenant communication operators and support using minimal recipient diagnostics.

interfaces.name: Learning Communications and Reminders API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Discard message bodies and transport payloads after delivery troubleshooting; retain only necessary delivery evidence under the agreed schedule.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Tenant communication operators and support using minimal recipient diagnostics. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

rootGroups.name: Learning Operations
rootGroups.description: Governed logical assets supporting learning operations.

assets.name: Learning Assignment Register
assets.description: Role- and audience-based learning requirements, due dates, rule versions and exclusion decisions.
assets.businessMeaning: Role- and audience-based learning requirements, due dates, rule versions and exclusion decisions.
assets.accessScope: L&D administrators and relevant managers; learners see their own assignments.

interfaces.name: Audience Assignments and Onboarding API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Retain while required for active assignments and the agreed qualification evidence period; preserve rule versions behind contested decisions.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: L&D administrators and relevant managers; learners see their own assignments. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Qualification and Exemption Record
assets.description: Requirement definition, validity interval, accepted evidence, policy version and named exemption approval. Does not certify legal compliance.
assets.businessMeaning: Requirement definition, validity interval, accepted evidence, policy version and named exemption approval. Does not certify legal compliance.
assets.accessScope: Authorized qualification administrators and managers; learners see their own status and evidence.

interfaces.name: Qualification and Renewal Management API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Use employer- and qualification-specific retention rules reviewed with the policy owner; keep evidence sufficient to explain past status without collecting medical data.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Authorized qualification administrators and managers; learners see their own status and evidence. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Training Session and Attendance Record
assets.description: Session schedule, capacity, waitlist, registration changes, attendance decisions and correction history.
assets.businessMeaning: Session schedule, capacity, waitlist, registration changes, attendance decisions and correction history.
assets.accessScope: Event organizers, booked learners and the relevant supplier; limit attendee visibility to the delivery need.

interfaces.name: Training Events and Attendance API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Retain attendance evidence under the relevant learning policy; discard surplus logistics and attendance-device data after reconciliation.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Event organizers, booked learners and the relevant supplier; limit attendee visibility to the delivery need. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Authorized Authoring Sources and Drafts
assets.description: Source documents, permitted uses, draft content and co-author changes; uploads may incidentally contain personal information requiring minimization.
assets.businessMeaning: Source documents, permitted uses, draft content and co-author changes; uploads may incidentally contain personal information requiring minimization.
assets.accessScope: Named authors and reviewers only; AI access is separately approved for the specific data scope.

interfaces.name: Source-Based Learning Authoring API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Remove unnecessary source documents after publication and the agreed review window; preserve minimal references sufficient to maintain the course.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Named authors and reviewers only; AI access is separately approved for the specific data scope. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Published Learning Versions and Rights
assets.description: Approved content packages, outcomes, source references, rights, review dates and withdrawal history. Personal source documents stay in the restricted source asset.
assets.businessMeaning: Approved content packages, outcomes, source references, rights, review dates and withdrawal history. Personal source documents stay in the restricted source asset.
assets.accessScope: Published content is limited by tenant and license entitlement; review history is restricted to authors and administrators.

interfaces.name: Learning Content Publication and Rights API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Keep immutable version references for learning evidence; stop serving withdrawn or expired content and honor source-license deletion duties.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Published content is limited by tenant and license entitlement; review history is restricted to authors and administrators. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: AI Generation Provenance and Evaluation
assets.description: Generation request scope, approved processor, source references, model/version, result and review outcome; minimize retained prompt content.
assets.businessMeaning: Generation request scope, approved processor, source references, model/version, result and review outcome; minimize retained prompt content.
assets.accessScope: Named author, quality reviewer and authorized assurance staff.

interfaces.name: AI Drafting Controls and Evaluation API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Retain minimized provenance for course review and investigation; prompt/response storage and provider retention require explicit scope approval.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Named author, quality reviewer and authorized assurance staff. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

rootGroups.name: Training Supply and Finance
rootGroups.description: Governed logical assets supporting training supply and finance.

assets.name: Learning Offers and Subscription Rights
assets.description: Normalized course offers, skill coverage, delivery mode, dates, price/terms references and employer subscription entitlements.
assets.businessMeaning: Normalized course offers, skill coverage, delivery mode, dates, price/terms references and employer subscription entitlements.
assets.accessScope: Eligible learners and administrators see relevant offers; supplier commercial configuration is restricted.

interfaces.name: Learning Offer Catalog and Entitlements API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Retain offer versions referenced by bookings; remove expired offerings from search while preserving contractual evidence.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Eligible learners and administrators see relevant offers; supplier commercial configuration is restricted. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Training Provider and Agreement Record
assets.description: Approved provider contacts, offer-maintenance responsibility, cancellation conditions and contracted invoice route.
assets.businessMeaning: Approved provider contacts, offer-maintenance responsibility, cancellation conditions and contracted invoice route.
assets.accessScope: Provider operators, employer procurement administrators and authorized service staff.

interfaces.name: Training Provider Operations API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Retain active supplier information and contract evidence under the agreed commercial schedule; remove obsolete personal contacts.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Provider operators, employer procurement administrators and authorized service staff. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Training Booking and Change Ledger
assets.description: The state and history of training requests, budget approval, provider confirmation, cancellation, substitution and transaction references.
assets.businessMeaning: The state and history of training requests, budget approval, provider confirmation, cancellation, substitution and transaction references.
assets.accessScope: The affected learner, employer approvers and provider operators see only their commitments.

interfaces.name: External Training Booking and Changes API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Retain booking and change evidence for reconciliation and agreed commercial dispute needs; remove unnecessary learner detail after that purpose ends.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: The affected learner, employer approvers and provider operators see only their commitments. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Learning Budget and Approval Ledger
assets.description: Allocations, delegated authority, approvals, reservations and releases for employer learning commitments.
assets.businessMeaning: Allocations, delegated authority, approvals, reservations and releases for employer learning commitments.
assets.accessScope: Named budget owners and approvers; learners see only their own request/allowance context.

interfaces.name: Learning Budget and Approval Control API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Retain approvals and commitments under employer finance policy and contract; finance remains the authoritative general ledger.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Named budget owners and approvers; learners see only their own request/allowance context. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Training Invoice Reconciliation Record
assets.description: Invoice references, booking matches, discrepancies, accepted credits and the applicable invoice-routing arrangement.
assets.businessMeaning: Invoice references, booking matches, discrepancies, accepted credits and the applicable invoice-routing arrangement.
assets.accessScope: Employer finance, supplier billing contacts and authorized reconciliation staff.

interfaces.name: Training Invoice and Credit Reconciliation API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Retain relevant financial evidence according to the responsible party's reviewed policy; avoid copying bank or payment-card data into learning records.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Employer finance, supplier billing contacts and authorized reconciliation staff. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

rootGroups.name: Outcome and Service Evidence
rootGroups.description: Governed logical assets supporting outcome and service evidence.

assets.name: Learning Outcome and Spend Measures
assets.description: Versioned metric definitions, cohort snapshots, denominators, lineage, missing-data flags and approved aggregate results.
assets.businessMeaning: Versioned metric definitions, cohort snapshots, denominators, lineage, missing-data flags and approved aggregate results.
assets.accessScope: Role-scoped dashboards; restrict identifiable drill-down and suppress small cohorts under the employer's approved policy.

interfaces.name: Learning Outcome Measurement API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Refresh projections from corrected records and minimize identifiable snapshots; retention follows the defined analysis purpose.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Role-scoped dashboards; restrict identifiable drill-down and suppress small cohorts under the employer's approved policy. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Integration Contract and Delivery Journal
assets.description: Endpoint contracts, correlation and idempotency keys, validation outcomes and delivery/replay checkpoints; secrets remain in protected runtime configuration.
assets.businessMeaning: Endpoint contracts, correlation and idempotency keys, validation outcomes and delivery/replay checkpoints; secrets remain in protected runtime configuration.
assets.accessScope: Employer integration owners and scoped service operators; payload inspection requires additional authorization.

interfaces.name: Integration Contracts and Exchange API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Use a short agreed replay window for raw payloads; retain minimal delivery and reconciliation evidence for operational accountability.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Employer integration owners and scoped service operators; payload inspection requires additional authorization. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Processing Approvals, Audit and Data Requests
assets.description: Access evidence, approved processing scopes and validated export, correction or deletion requests with disposition history.
assets.businessMeaning: Access evidence, approved processing scopes and validated export, correction or deletion requests with disposition history.
assets.accessScope: Authorized employer privacy/security owners and scoped platform assurance staff.

interfaces.name: Privacy, Audit and Processing Controls API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Apply agreed evidence retention and verified holds; never treat an open hold as justification for indefinite retention of unrelated personal data.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Authorized employer privacy/security owners and scoped platform assurance staff. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Service Incidents and Recovery Evidence
assets.description: Minimized health signals, incidents, recovery decisions and exercise outcomes with tenant-impact references.
assets.businessMeaning: Minimized health signals, incidents, recovery decisions and exercise outcomes with tenant-impact references.
assets.accessScope: Service operators see technical context; employers see their own impact and agreed incident information.

interfaces.name: Service Reliability and Recovery API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Keep operational evidence for service improvement under the approved schedule; redact learner content and secrets from telemetry.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Service operators see technical context; employers see their own impact and agreed incident information. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Learning Support and Correction Cases
assets.description: The reported problem, affected references, assigned owner, authorized correction and confirmation that downstream state was repaired.
assets.businessMeaning: The reported problem, affected references, assigned owner, authorized correction and confirmation that downstream state was repaired.
assets.accessScope: The reporting party and assigned support staff; diagnostic access is time-limited and purpose-scoped.

interfaces.name: Learning Support and Record Correction API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Retain minimized case evidence for the agreed support and dispute window; avoid storing unnecessary assessment narrative or source documents.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: The reporting party and assigned support staff; diagnostic access is time-limited and purpose-scoped. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

assets.name: Implementation and Migration Acceptance
assets.description: Rollout scope, source totals, mapping versions, batch results, sample checks, pilot acceptance and operational handover evidence.
assets.businessMeaning: Rollout scope, source totals, mapping versions, batch results, sample checks, pilot acceptance and operational handover evidence.
assets.accessScope: Employer implementation owners and assigned consultants; restrict raw historical records to migration processing.

interfaces.name: Academy Implementation and Migration API
interfaces.description: Authorized records are accessed through the owning brick's interface; consumers do not receive unrestricted database access.

governance.retention: Proposed policy, subject to employer agreement: Remove raw extracts after accepted reconciliation and the agreed repair window; preserve mappings, totals and acceptance evidence under the service contract.
governance.residency: To be agreed with the employer and verified against contracted hosting and subprocessor scope; no region is asserted.
governance.sharingPolicy: Employer implementation owners and assigned consultants; restrict raw historical records to migration processing. No cross-employer sharing by default; derived analytics and AI processing require approved scopes.

stores.name: Tenant Access Store
stores.description: Proposed logical store for tenant membership and access policy.

stores.name: Learning Operations Store
stores.description: Proposed logical store for workforce projections, learning records, plans and qualifications.

stores.name: Knowledge Package Store
stores.description: Proposed object storage for authorized source material and versioned content; separate access scopes apply.

stores.name: Training Commitments Store
stores.description: Proposed logical commercial record store; distinct from the employer finance ledger.

stores.name: Outcome Measurement Store
stores.description: Proposed derived measurement store with cohort scoping and correction lineage.

stores.name: Exchange and Migration Journal
stores.description: Proposed bounded replay and reconciliation store; credentials are excluded.

stores.name: Assurance Evidence Store
stores.description: Proposed access-controlled operational, support and audit evidence storage.
